scientific_question: Do g05-g12 remain infeasible in either CUDA lane when the full fp32 accumulator tile is not reserved in shared memory?
selection_rule: Within each lane, retain every legacy-correct screen result, rank by median of two process medians, robust-validate the frozen top three under both fused-v2 mixed gates, then confirm all robust-passing selected cells in 15 within-lane randomized complete blocks.
failure_rule: Every build, attribute, launch, correctness, and robust-gate failure is retained and is ineligible; thresholds are never changed.
primary_estimand: Per-lane minimum median process time among robust-passing streamed-epilogue candidates; compared descriptively with the receipt-bound v1 frontier.

inference.cell_interval: order-statistic interval [x4,x12], 96.5% binomial coverage for a continuous population median at n=15
inference.lane_minimum: minimum cell point estimate among the robust-passing frozen top three
inference.block_bootstrap_rule: resample the 15 rep blocks jointly within lane; recompute every candidate median and their minimum; percentile 2.5/97.5 interval
inference.ordering_rule: no strict winner claim when simultaneous cell intervals overlap

claim_limit: This is a prospective implementation-recipe ablation, not a retroactive replacement of v1 and not by itself a language ceiling.
